bed_type.title: Bed Type
bed_type.description:
What type of bed do you want to control?

**Waterbed:** High thermal mass (300-700L water). Slow heating (~0.7°C/h), stores heat like a battery. Min. 24°C (condensation protection!), gentle ramps (1°C/h max).

**Heating Pad:** Low thermal mass. Fast heating (minutes!), no heat storage. Can be completely OFF, no ramp limits needed.

safety_info.title: ⚠️ Safety Notice
safety_info.description:
**IMPORTANT:** Make sure your bed heater's physical thermostat is set to **MAXIMUM (38°C)**!

Only this way Home Assistant can precisely control the temperature.

**For waterbeds:** The minimum temperature of 24°C prevents condensation and mold. Never turn off the heater completely!

**The hardware thermostat remains as a safety backup!**

global_settings.title: 🌐 Global Settings
global_settings.description: Basic settings for the entire system.

data_description.warm_from: When should the bed start being warm? Preheating starts automatically earlier.
data_description.warm_until: Until when should the bed stay warm? Also serves as default wake time.
data_description.summer_threshold: Above this outdoor temperature, summer mode activates. Recommended: 25°C.
data_description.temperature_offset: Fine-tune all temperatures. +1.0 = everything 1°C warmer, -1.0 = everything 1°C cooler.
data_description.co2_sensor: 💨 CO2 sensor in bedroom. Contributes 25% to sleep score.

zone_sensors.title: 📡 Select Zone
zone_sensors.description: Which zone would you like to edit?

data_description.zone_index: Select the zone whose sensors you want to change.

edit_zone_sensors.title: 📡 Sensors – {zone_name}
edit_zone_sensors.description: Change the hardware assignment for this zone. Optional fields can be left empty.

data_description.heater: The switch or relay that turns the heater on/off (smart plug, Zigbee switch, input_boolean).
data_description.temp_sensor: Temperature sensor in the water or on the mattress. Without sensor: basic mode only (timer).
data_description.power_sensor: Power sensor from smart plug (Watts). Enables precise energy statistics and better presence detection.
data_description.presence_sensor: Dedicated presence sensor (e.g. pressure mat, mmWave radar). Without sensor: detection via temperature analysis.
data_description.moisture_sensor: Moisture sensor for sweat detection and leak alarm.
data_description.air_temp_sensor:
🌡️ Optional: Second temperature sensor ON TOP of the core (e.g. SHT41).

Measures surface temperature between mattress and blanket.

✅ Unlocks:

1. **Blanket Check**: Detects if bed is covered
2. **Sweat Detection 2.0**: Cross-correlation Temp × Humidity
3. **Better Presence**: Body heat signal from above

zone_settings_select.description: Which zone would you like to configure?

data_description.zone_index: Select the zone whose settings you want to adjust.

edit_zone_settings.title: 🌡️ Settings – {zone_name}
edit_zone_settings.description: Adjust wake time, temperatures and sleep tracking for this zone. Empty temperature fields = seasonal automatic.

data_description.wake_mode: How is the wake time determined? Fixed = always same time, Alarm = from your phone/alarm entity, Hybrid = alarm if set, otherwise fixed time.
data_description.wake_time: Fixed wake time. Used in 'Fixed' mode and as fallback in 'Hybrid' mode.
data_description.alarm_entity: Sensor containing the next alarm time (e.g. sensor.next_alarm). Used in 'Alarm' and 'Hybrid' modes.
data_description.weekend_offset_hours: How many hours the wake time is shifted on weekends and holidays.
data_description.sleep_temp: Temperature at sleep onset. Empty = seasonal automatic (Summer ~27°C, Winter ~29°C).
data_description.deep_sleep_temp: Coolest point during deep sleep for optimal recovery. Empty = seasonal automatic.
data_description.wake_temp: Temperature at wake time – gentle warming supports natural waking. Empty = seasonal automatic.
data_description.sleep_stage_entity: Sleep stages from a wearable (Fitbit, Withings, Apple Watch etc.). Overrides the biorhythm curve with real sleep data.

mode_settings.title: 🎛️ Mode Settings
mode_settings.description: Configure temperature settings for each special mode.

data_description.sick_mode_temp: Constant temperature during sick mode. Recommended: 30-32°C for muscle relaxation and recovery.
data_description.sick_mode_days: How many days sick mode stays active before auto-deactivating.
data_description.boost_offset: Temperature increase above current curve during quick heat (boost). Recommended: +2-3°C.
data_description.away_temp: Minimum holding temperature in vacation mode. For waterbeds never below 24°C (condensation protection)!
data_description.comfort_offset: Extra warmth for sleeping in on weekends. The wake curve is delayed accordingly.
